name: HG Metals
old_description: Embark on a journey of excellence with our distinguished construction and installation services, where every project is executed with unparalleled precision and a commitment to enduring quality. Experience a fusion of innovative techniques and timeless craftsmanship, tailored to transform your visions into reality.
about:
HG Metals operates from Indianapolis, Indiana, as an active division of HGMC Supply, Inc. The company is led by President and Owner Ashley Collins, who brings over 15 years of corporate management experience. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the team has delivered steel fabrication services for over two decades.

The shop specializes in structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication, producing items such as structural framing, support systems, custom stairs, rails, ladders, mezzanines, equipment platforms, canopies, and other specialty metal fabrications. Fabrication is performed in-house using modern CNC equipment, and welding is carried out by personnel certified to AWS D1.1 unlimited standards. The facility ships completed assemblies nationwide.

HG Metals serves commercial and construction clients across Indiana and the broader United States, including general contractors and developers working on large-scale commercial developments as well as custom one-of-a-kind structures. The company's project portfolio spans structural steel packages and miscellaneous metal components for a variety of building types.

The company emphasizes communication, coordination, and accountability from bid through final delivery, aiming to keep steel on the critical path of a project. This approach is framed as building relationships and solving problems rather than simply fabricating steel.
